'''2007 New York State Championship Joe Pinto LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' N1 you Q
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
